rawSources.locator: AFDC all-electric-car L66: onboard charger converts incoming AC to DC, communicates with charging equipment, and monitors voltage/current/temperature/state of charge while charging. absoluteDifficulty.rationale: The question tests EV charging architecture: recognizing which in-vehicle component communicates with charging equipment and monitors the pack’s voltage, current, temperature, and charge level during charging. An adult familiar with BEV systems is likely to know this onboard-charger role; someone outside the topic may narrow toward the charger or battery but cannot confidently distinguish the charger’s communication/monitoring duties from battery storage, power-flow control, and motor propulsion. It avoids unsupported maximum-power and DC-fast-charge claims.
